name: Halfling

name: Behemoth

name: Imp Crucible

name: Cursed Temple

name: Graveyard

name: Warren

description: A knight in gilded plate armour and a golden plumed helmet riding a brown horse fully covered by a white caparison chequered with royal blue and a steel head plate, holding a long red-and-white striped lance upright.

name: Angel
description: A tall angel with long black hair in a white robe with blue trim, large white-and-grey feathered wings folded behind the back, holding a long sword point-down, barefoot.

name: Archangel
description: A tall winged warrior in gleaming golden-bronze plate armour with a dark round shield, large silver-white feathered wings folded behind the back, holding a broad sword point-down.

name: Centaur Captain
description: A centaur with the body of a pale cream-grey horse and a muscular tanned human torso with leather straps and a small golden helmet, holding a tall halberd raised.

name: Dwarf
description: A stocky dwarf with a long bushy orange-red beard, a simple grey steel cap, a moss-green tunic with a brown leather belt and brown boots, holding a battle axe low at his side.

name: Battle Dwarf
description: A stocky dwarf in dark steel armour with a golden helmet crowned by two tall upswept horns, a long grey-white beard and a red belt, holding a heavy battle axe.

name: Wood Elf
description: A blond elf archer in a bright green tunic and green leggings with brown leather boots and bracers, holding a tall wooden longbow, a quiver of red-fletched arrows on the back.

name: Grand Elf
description: An elf archer in dark brown-black leather armour with gold studs and pale grey leggings, holding a tall recurved longbow, a quiver of red-fletched arrows on the back.

name: Pegasus
description: A cream-white winged horse with large feathered wings raised close above its back, carrying a slim female elf rider in light bronze armour holding a thin sword.

name: Silver Pegasus
description: A white winged horse with a golden-blond mane wearing black-and-gold armour plates on its chest and legs, white feathered wings raised close above its back, carrying a red-haired elf rider.

name: Dendroid Guard
description: A walking tree-man: a thick gnarled trunk of rough brown bark forming the body and legs, branch arms with twig fingers and a few tufts of green leaves on the crown and shoulders.

name: Dendroid Soldier
description: A walking tree-man of dark reddish-brown gnarled bark, branch arms with twig fingers and clusters of small dark crimson and magenta leaves on the crown and around the roots.

name: Unicorn
description: A pure white unicorn standing proudly with a long straight spiral horn, a flowing white mane and tail and pale hooves.

name: War Unicorn
description: A white unicorn with a golden spiral horn, a cream-gold mane and tail and golden feathering above its hooves, standing in a proud stance.

name: Gold Dragon
description: A large golden dragon with shining yellow-gold scales, orange-red belly plates and fins, horns on its head, golden bat-like wings folded against its body, crouching on powerful legs with the tail curled around.

name: Master Gremlin
description: A small green-skinned gremlin with big pointed ears and a tall pointed royal-blue wizard hat, wearing a long blue robe, a heavy iron ball and chain at its feet.

name: Stone Gargoyle
description: A crouching gargoyle of rough grey-brown stone with bat-like stone wings folded on its back, short horns, glowing red eyes, clawed hands and feet.

name: Obsidian Gargoyle
description: A crouching gargoyle of glossy black obsidian with dark bat-like wings folded on its back, curved horns, glowing red eyes and sharp claws.

name: Stone Golem
description: A bulky humanoid golem built of rough tan-grey sandstone blocks, a small head sunk between massive shoulders, thick arms and legs.

name: Iron Golem
description: A bulky humanoid golem of dark rust-brown riveted iron plates, a small helmet-like head, heavy arms and legs.

name: Mage
description: A mage with long dark-brown hair and beard in a long crimson robe with gold trim, holding a tall plain wooden staff.

name: Arch Mage
description: An old mage with a long white beard in a crimson robe and a tall pointed crimson hat, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing green orb.

name: Genie
description: A genie with pale icy-blue skin and a blue topknot, a red open vest and sash, arms folded over the chest, its lower body a swirling column of pale-blue vapour instead of legs.

name: Master Genie
description: A genie with deep-blue skin wearing a red turban with gold, golden armbands and collar, arms folded over the chest, its lower body a swirling column of bright blue vapour instead of legs.

name: Naga
description: A naga: the upper body of a pale-skinned woman with long black hair and several arms holding curved swords, rising from a long coiled dark grey-brown serpent tail.

name: Naga Queen
description: A naga queen: a pale woman's torso with a golden crown and golden jewellery and several arms holding curved swords, rising from a long coiled serpent tail of black scales patterned with dark crimson.

name: Giant
description: A tall muscular giant in grey-bronze plate armour and a helmet with a red crest, holding a jagged blue-white lightning bolt like a sword.

name: Titan
description: A tall muscular giant in polished golden plate armour and a golden helmet with a red crest, raising a crackling blue-white lightning bolt in one hand.

name: Familiar
description: A small crouching imp with pinkish-red skin, small red bat wings, short white horns, pointed ears and a long thin tail, grinning.

name: Gog
description: A lean demon with ochre-brown leathery skin, pointed ears, a long thin tail and backward-bent legs, holding a burning fireball in one raised hand.

name: Magog
description: A lean demon with red-orange skin, small horns, a long thin tail and backward-bent legs, holding a large burning fireball in one raised hand.

name: Hell Hound
description: A large hell hound: a heavy mastiff-like beast with dark grey-brown shaggy fur, red eyes and a glowing red mouth, standing on four legs.

name: Cerberus
description: A huge three-headed hound with dark brown shaggy fur, three snarling heads with glowing red mouths, standing on four legs.

name: Demon
description: A demon with a muscular pinkish-tan torso, a bestial head with one long curved horn, shaggy dark-brown goat legs and a long thin tail.

name: Horned Demon
description: A demon with dark red-brown skin, a long upswept horn on its bestial head, a golden-yellow armour plate on its chest, shaggy dark goat legs and a long thin tail.

name: Pit Fiend
description: A tall gaunt demon with orange-red skin, a narrow horned head, a brown loincloth and a long tail coiled around its feet, standing hunched.

name: Pit Lord
description: A tall demon with dark crimson-red skin, curved horns, a brown leather harness across its chest and a long tail coiled at its feet.

name: Efreeti
description: An efreet: a muscular red-skinned humanoid with a bald head, its lower body a roaring column of orange and yellow flames instead of legs.

name: Efreet Sultan
description: An efreet with crimson-red skin wearing a golden turban and golden jewellery, its lower body a roaring column of orange and yellow flames instead of legs.

name: Devil
description: A tall devil with red skin and big curling pale ram horns in a long black sleeveless robe with red trim, holding a long wooden staff that ends in a curved scythe blade near the ground.

name: Arch Devil
description: A tall devil with red skin and tall pale antler-like horns in black armour with crimson plates and spiked shoulder guards, holding a long wooden staff that ends in a curved scythe blade.

name: Skeleton Warrior
description: A skeleton warrior of grey-yellowed bones wearing a dark iron helmet and pieces of rusty armour, carrying a round dark wooden shield and a curved sword.

name: Zombie
description: A hunched zombie with pale grey skin, ragged olive-green and brown clothes and bare bony feet, carrying a wooden pickaxe.

name: Wight
description: A hovering wight: a tall hunched figure wrapped in a tattered brown hooded shroud, its face hidden in the hood, the ragged robe tapering to the ground without visible legs.

name: Wraith
description: A wraith in a tattered black-brown hooded robe with a pale skull-like face and bony clawed hands, the ragged hem trailing on the ground.

name: Vampire
description: A pale vampire with grey skin, white hair and red eyes in a dark grey doublet with a white sash, hunched with clawed hands raised.

name: Vampire Lord
description: A white-haired vampire lord with pale skin in a long flowing dark-red and orange cloak whose hem dissolves into dark ragged mist, one clawed hand raised.

name: Lich
description: A lich: a skeletal figure of yellowed bones wrapped in grey rags with gold trim and a simple golden headband, holding a tall dark wooden staff.

name: Power Lich
description: A skeletal lich in a long grey robe with gold ornaments and a tall golden crown, holding a tall golden staff topped with a black orb gripped by golden claws.

name: Black Knight
description: A knight in black spiked plate armour with a horned black helmet and glowing red eye slits, riding a dark brown horse with a black caparison trimmed in red, a curved sword in hand.

name: Dread Knight
description: A knight in black plate armour with glowing red eye slits riding a dark horse fully covered by a black caparison with red trim, white bone skull ornaments and spikes.

name: Bone Dragon
description: A skeletal dragon of yellowed bones: a horned skull, a bony ribcage, folded skeletal wings without membranes, crouching on bony legs with a long vertebrae tail.

name: Ghost Dragon
description: A spectral skeletal dragon of translucent pale white and ice-blue ghostly bones, a horned skull and folded skeletal wings, crouching.

name: Infernal Troglodyte
description: A hunched eyeless troglodyte with mottled red-orange and green reptilian skin and a row of sharp yellow-orange spikes along its back, holding a spear.

name: Harpy
description: A harpy: a woman's upper body with tan skin and long dark hair, large dark-brown feathered wings raised close to the body, orange-yellow bird legs with sharp talons.

name: Harpy Hag
description: A gaunt harpy hag with pale skin and stringy grey-white hair, large brown feathered wings raised close to the body, orange-yellow bird legs with long talons.

name: Beholder
description: A round floating orange-brown fleshy orb with one large eye in front, hanging on many long thin brown tentacles with red tips that reach the ground.

name: Evil Eye
description: A round floating pinkish-brown fleshy orb with a large central eye and several short eyestalks with pink eyes on top, hanging on many long thin brown tentacles with red tips.

name: Medusa
description: A gorgon woman with a mass of green snakes for hair and pale greenish skin, holding a bow, her lower body a long coiled serpent tail of dark green-olive scales with a pale lavender belly.

name: Medusa Queen
description: A gorgon queen with golden-brown snakes for hair, a golden diadem and a gold breastplate, holding a golden bow, her lower body a coiled serpent tail of orange-brown scales with a pale belly.

name: Minotaur
description: A minotaur: a muscular bull-headed man with red-brown fur, long upcurved pale horns, glowing red eyes, a red-brown loincloth and hooves, holding a double-bladed steel axe low.

name: Minotaur King
description: A minotaur with lighter tan-orange fur and long pale horns, wearing golden shoulder guards, armbands and belt, holding a large steel double-bladed axe.

name: Manticore
description: A manticore: a lion body with tawny orange-brown fur and a darker red mane, leathery brown bat wings folded on the back and a segmented scorpion tail curling over its back.

name: Scorpicore
description: A manticore-like beast with deep crimson-red fur and mane, red leathery wings folded on the back and a red segmented scorpion tail arched over its back.

name: Red Dragon
description: A large bright-red dragon with curved horns and a spiny back, violet-purple wing membranes on wings folded against its body, crouching with its tail curled around.

name: Black Dragon
description: A large black dragon with glossy black scales and golden-yellow highlights on its horns and belly, dark indigo-purple wing membranes folded against its body, crouching.

name: Hobgoblin
description: A green-skinned hobgoblin with pointed ears in a tan leather helmet and ochre padded leather armour with brass studs, holding a spiked flail.

name: Wolf Raider
description: A green-skinned goblin in a leather helmet and studded tan armour with a curved sword, riding a huge black wolf with yellow eyes and bared fangs.

name: Orc
description: A green-skinned orc in a brown leather hood and fur-trimmed brown leather armour with a white cloth kilt, holding a short throwing axe.

name: Orc Chieftain
description: A green-skinned orc chieftain in a steel helmet with white horns, dark leather and steel armour with a white cloth kilt, holding a battle axe.

name: Ogre
description: A hulking green-skinned ogre with long brown hair, a bare heavy torso and a red-orange loincloth with brown leather straps, carrying a heavy wooden club.

name: Ogre Mage
description: A hulking green-skinned ogre with a red topknot in a dark violet-grey robe with brown leather belts, holding a tall staff topped with a pale horned skull.

name: Roc
description: A giant eagle-like bird with dark brown plumage, a pale head, a big yellow hooked beak and yellow talons, its wings half folded against its body.

name: Thunderbird
description: A giant eagle-like bird with shining golden-yellow plumage, an orange hooked beak and yellow talons, its golden wings half folded against its body.

name: Cyclops
description: A one-eyed giant with tanned skin and shaggy brown hair, bare-chested with a grey-brown leather loincloth and leg wraps, carrying a large pale boulder in both arms.

name: Cyclops King
description: A bald one-eyed giant with tanned skin wearing an ochre leather kilt with golden plates and a golden shoulder guard, carrying a large pale boulder.

name: Ancient Behemoth
description: A huge hunched beast with shaggy pale grey-white fur mottled with dark streaks, enormous forearms with long curved claws, a horned head with red eyes and an open red maw.

name: Gnoll Marauder
description: A hyena-headed gnoll with orange-brown fur in dark studded leather armour with shoulder guards, holding a spiked flail.

name: Lizard Warrior
description: An upright lizard warrior with a blue-grey scaly head and a bright blue frilled crest, a tan-orange chest and dark blue scaled legs, brown leather straps, holding a bow.

name: Gorgon
description: A massive bull covered in overlapping green and bronze metallic scale plates, with dark green legs, short pale horns and red eyes.

name: Mighty Gorgon
description: A massive bull covered in dark brown-black iron scale plates with dark-red armoured hindquarters, a blue collar band, pale horns and yellow eyes.

name: Serpent Fly
description: A giant serpent-like insect with a long thin segmented green-and-yellow body curving in an S, an orange head and two pairs of translucent pale-blue dragonfly wings.

name: Dragon Fly
description: A giant dragonfly-like creature with a long segmented orange-and-green body, a red head with bulging eyes and translucent yellow-green dragonfly wings.

name: Basilisk
description: A large low lizard on four splayed legs with dark green scales, a spiky crest on its head and back and glowing yellow eyes.

name: Greater Basilisk
description: A large low lizard on four splayed legs with olive-green scales, purple fins and frills on its head and back and rows of horns and spikes.

name: Wyvern
description: A wyvern standing on two legs: a bright yellow-green scaly body, a long curved neck with open jaws and leathery wings with dull purple-red membranes folded at its sides.

name: Wyvern Monarch
description: A wyvern on two legs with an olive-tan scaly body, a red-brown head crowned with spiky horns and large red-brown leathery wings folded at its sides.

name: Hydra
description: A hydra: a heavy olive-green and yellow scaled body on four short legs with five long necks rising up, each ending in a snake-like head with a red mouth.

name: Chaos Hydra
description: A hydra with a heavy golden-brown scaled body mottled with pink and red and seven long necks tangled upward, each ending in a fanged head.

name: Air Elemental
description: An air elemental: a translucent pale-cyan humanoid upper body with arms folded, its lower body a swirling white whirlwind.

name: Earth Elemental
description: An earth elemental: a hulking humanoid of packed brown earth and rock with lumpy shoulders and heavy fists.

name: Fire Elemental
description: A fire elemental: a humanoid figure made entirely of bright yellow and orange flames.

name: Water Elemental
description: A mermaid-like being of glossy teal-green water with a finned crest on its head, a pale belly and a long coiled fish tail ending in a large pink-red fin.

name: Gold Golem
description: A bulky humanoid golem of polished riveted gold plates with a small helmet-like head and heavy arms.

name: Diamond Golem
description: A bulky humanoid golem of translucent pale-blue faceted diamond crystal with smooth glinting surfaces.

name: Sprite
description: A tiny fairy girl with long brown hair in a long violet dress with large blue-and-black butterfly wings, standing on tiptoe.

name: Psychic Elemental
description: A tall faceless figure in a long dark brown-black robe reaching the ground, with a high crimson collar and a crimson hooded head glowing faintly pink.

name: Magic Elemental
description: A tall figure in a long flowing crimson-red cloak over a shimmering silver-violet robe, with a pale silver-lilac crested head.

name: Ice Elemental
description: A mermaid-like being of icy blue-violet with spiky icicle hair, a pale belly and a long coiled tail ending in a dark blue fin.

name: Magma Elemental
description: A magma elemental: a hulking humanoid of dark molten rock with glowing orange-red cracks all over its body.

name: Storm Elemental
description: A storm elemental: a hunched humanoid upper body of dark grey storm clouds rising from a swirling dark grey whirlwind.

name: Energy Elemental
description: An energy elemental: a humanoid figure of glowing deep-blue energy with crackling light-blue lightning sparks along its body.

name: Firebird
description: A large bird of prey with brilliant orange-red plumage, a golden crest and a yellow beak, its fiery orange wings folded against its body.

name: Phoenix
description: A phoenix: a large bird whose plumage is made of bright yellow and orange flames, wings folded close, yellow talons.

name: Azure Dragon
description: A large deep-blue dragon with glossy sapphire scales, light-blue spines and horns, blue wings folded against its body, crouching on clawed feet.

name: Crystal Dragon
description: A large dragon made of faceted translucent red-orange crystal with sharp crystal spikes along its back and head, crystal wings folded, crouching.

name: Faerie Dragon
description: A slender purple-violet dragon with golden curled horns and translucent pale green-pink butterfly-like wings raised over its back, sitting on its haunches.

name: Rust Dragon
description: A large dragon with rusty orange-brown scales, green eyes, small horns and tattered brown wings folded against its body, crouching.

name: Enchanter
description: An enchanter with long dark hair and beard in a long royal-blue robe patterned with white swirls, a silver-grey shoulder mantle and a tall thin silver staff.

name: Sharpshooter
description: An archer in a long dark-green hooded cloak over dark leather, crouched and drawing a large recurved wooden longbow.

name: Boar
description: A huge brown wild boar with tusks and a bristly back, ridden by a green-skinned orc in brown leather armour and a horned helmet.

name: Mummy
description: A gaunt mummy wrapped in pale linen bandages with a red loincloth and a golden striped pharaoh headdress, holding a tall golden staff topped with a dark ornament.

name: Nomad
description: A desert nomad in white and tan robes and a white turban with a curved scimitar, riding a black horse with a cream saddle cloth.

name: Rogue
description: A rogue in a long dark grey-black hooded cloak, red trousers and brown boots, holding a short dagger raised.

name: Troll
description: A big hunched troll with olive-green warty skin, green spiky hair, a pot belly and long arms, holding a bloody haunch of raw meat.

name: Cannon
description: A heavy dark iron cannon barrel mounted on a wooden carriage with two large spoked orange-brown wheels and a long trail.

name: Sea Dog
description: A grizzled bearded pirate in a black tricorn hat with a red feather plume, a long black coat with golden epaulettes and buckles and a red sash, a flintlock pistol raised in one hand and a cutlass in the other.

name: Oceanid
description: A slender water maiden with silver-white hair in a blue and gold armoured bodice, her lower body a swirling column of white foamy water.

name: Crew Mate
description: A muscular dark-skinned sailor, bare-chested with short black hair, a red sash and baggy dark-brown knee trousers, holding a curved cutlass.

name: Seaman
description: A dark-skinned sailor with a red bandana, a sleeveless dark-blue vest, a red sash and baggy dark trousers, holding a curved cutlass.

name: Pirate
description: A bearded pirate with a red bandana, a white shirt under a long dark blue-grey waistcoat, a red sash and dark trousers, a flintlock pistol raised and a cutlass lowered.

name: Corsair
description: A pirate in a black tricorn hat with a red band and a long crimson-red coat with gold buttons, a flintlock pistol raised and a cutlass lowered.

name: Stormbird
description: A large bird of prey with dark slate-blue plumage, tan-gold wing edges and a golden beak and talons, its wings half-raised close to the body.

name: Ayssid
description: A large bird of prey with deep navy-blue plumage, a crest of golden spikes on its head, golden spurs on the wings and a golden beak and talons, its wings half-raised close to the body.

name: Sea Witch
description: A woman with dark hair and a red bandana, a white blouse with puffed sleeves, a dark blue vest and red sash, dark trousers and tall black boots, holding a glowing blue orb.

name: Sorceress
description: A sorceress with dark hair and a golden diadem in a long dark-blue robe with gold trim and white sleeves and a long blue cape, holding a glowing blue orb.

name: Nix
description: A humanoid with a green crocodile-like head and olive-green scaly skin, brown leather armour and a red loincloth, holding a tall spear upright.

name: Nix Warrior
description: A bulky reptilian warrior with a large spiked brown turtle shell on its back and shoulders, teal-green scale armour and a red loincloth, holding a tall spear.

name: Sea Serpent
description: A huge sea serpent coiled in an S-shape with its head raised, dark blue-black scales on the back and a pale cream segmented belly.

name: Haspid
description: A huge sea serpent coiled in an S-shape with its head raised, crimson-red scales, a pale segmented belly, orange-red fin frills and spiky horns on its head.

name: Satyr
description: A satyr with a bare tan torso, dark curly hair and beard, curved goat horns and shaggy brown goat legs with hooves, holding a short wooden pipe.

name: Fangarm
description: A winged humanoid horror with olive-green ridged skin, an octopus-like head with a beard of tentacles, dark brown-green bat wings folded on its back and clawed feet.

name: Leprechaun
description: A small man with a bushy ginger beard, a tall green top hat, a green frock coat and black buckled shoes, smoking a pipe and leaning on a walking stick.

name: Steel Golem
description: A bulky humanoid golem of polished silver steel plates with dark joints and a small helmet-like head.

name: Halfling Grenadier
description: A small halfling with a black bowler hat and a brown beard, a white shirt and a red-and-gold waistcoat, dark trousers and bare hairy feet, carrying a leather satchel with round black bombs.

name: Mechanic
description: A red-haired woman in a dark cap with goggles and a long brown leather coat with belts and pouches, holding a big iron wrench.

name: Engineer
description: A blonde woman in a black hat with goggles, a white blouse and a long grey coat with belts, holding a long metal tool with a glowing orange tip.

name: Armadillo
description: A large armadillo with an arched orange-brown banded shell with pale bony spikes along its ridge, brown clawed legs and a pointed snout.

name: Bellwether Armadillo
description: A large armadillo with a darker red-brown banded shell, bigger pale bony spikes along its ridge and a pale horn on its snout.

name: Automaton
description: A clockwork machine like a big four-legged spider: a round copper-brown body with dark iron plates and a small chimney, thin copper legs and a glowing orange eye.

name: Sentinel Automaton
description: A clockwork four-legged spider machine with polished brass-gold legs and armour plates over a steel body, spikes on top and a glowing orange eye.

name: Sandworm
description: A giant sandworm rearing up in an S-curve with an ochre-orange segmented belly and purple-grey ridged armour plates on its back, a round fanged maw.

name: Olgoi-Khorkhoi
description: A giant worm coiled and rearing up with dark purple-grey ridged back plates and a pale whitish-grey segmented belly, a round fanged maw.

name: Gunslinger
description: A gunslinger in a black wide-brimmed hat with a red feather and a long tan-brown duster coat with yellow trim, holding a long rifle on his shoulder.

name: Bounty Hunter
description: A gunman in a black wide-brimmed hat with a red feather and a red scarf over his face, a long black coat with golden shoulder plates and trim, holding a long brass-fitted rifle.

name: Couatl
description: A feathered winged serpent sitting upright in its coils, covered in bright rainbow plumage: a red-and-yellow crested head, blue wings folded at its side and green, yellow, purple and red feathers along its body.

name: Crimson Couatl
description: A feathered winged serpent sitting upright in its coils with crimson-red feathers and crest, golden scales on its chest and belly and dark-red feathered wings folded at its side.

name: Dreadnought
description: A hulking steam-powered walking machine of riveted copper-bronze plates with grey steel pipes and joints, heavy arms and a short chimney on its back.

name: Juggernaut
description: A hulking steam-powered walking machine of polished brass-yellow riveted plates with dark iron joints, heavy arms and a tall chimney on its back.

name: Kobold Foreman
description: A small kobold with blue-grey skin in dark iron armour with brass trim and a brass helmet, carrying a pickaxe raised over his shoulder.

name: Mountain Ram
description: A large wild mountain ram with sleek dark-brown fur, slender legs and long horns sweeping backward in big curves.

name: Argali
description: A large wild ram with pale icy-blue and white fur and massive golden curled horns, standing on slender legs.

name: Snow Elf
description: A northern elf with dark hair tied back in pale fur-trimmed leather armour with teal-green accents, holding a tall spear upright and a bundle of javelins at the hip.

name: Steel Elf
description: A northern elf in a steel helmet with a blue crest, chainmail and fur, carrying a big round blue-and-white patterned shield and a tall spear.

name: Yeti
description: A hulking yeti with shaggy white-grey fur and a pinkish face and hands, holding a tall wooden staff topped with a heavy dark stone hammer head.

name: Yeti Runemaster
description: A hulking white-furred yeti wearing a dark brown cloak with gold trim and blue gauntlets, holding a tall staff topped with a big blue-and-gold rune-carved hammer head.

name: Shaman
description: A hunched shaman in a heavy brown fur-trimmed hooded robe with bone and rope ornaments, the face hidden behind a pale mask, holding a large round skin frame drum.

name: Great Shaman
description: A shaman in a heavy black robe with tan bone trim and a large deer-antler headdress, a golden mask for a face, holding a large round skin frame drum.

name: Mammoth
description: A woolly mammoth with shaggy brown fur, a domed head, small ears and long curved ivory tusks.

name: War Mammoth
description: A woolly mammoth with dark brown fur covered by a dark leather war blanket with blue borders and metal studs, long curved ivory tusks.

name: Jotunn
description: A massive giant with a braided red beard and a steel helmet trimmed with white fur, a turquoise tunic under brown fur and leather with wide belts, holding a big axe at his side.

name: Jotunn Warlord
description: A massive giant with a white beard and a tall bronze helmet with large wing-like crests, turquoise accents and fur-and-leather armour, carrying a huge round bronze shield and a curved blade.

name: Basilisk Pit
description: A rectangular pit enclosed by low walls of grey cut stone, its sunken floor of dark reddish earth visible from above, a narrow opening in the front corner of the wall.

name: Behemoth Crag
description: A tall jagged crag of dark brown rock with many spiky pinnacles and deep crevices, a glowing red-orange cave mouth at its foot.

name: Pillar of Eyes
description: A grotesque organic pillar of olive-green flesh rising from a spread of thick tentacle-like roots, a big round eye in the middle of its stem and several bulging eyes on short stalks crowning its top.

name: Hall of Darkness
description: A tall gothic hall of dark blue-grey stone with many slender black spires and pinnacles, pointed lancet windows and a dark arched doorway at the front.

name: Dragon Vault
description: A tall steep spire of brown rock with a massive grey stone vault front built into its foot: heavy iron-barred grates above a stone threshold.

name: Training Grounds
description: A large round pavilion tent with vertical blue-and-white stripes, a conical roof with a scalloped valance and a dark entrance opening at the front.

name: Air Elemental Conflux
description: A round platform of dark stone ringed by six tall pale bluish-white crystal obelisks on dark pedestals, a big swirling dome of white cloud and mist in its centre.

name: Portal of Glory
description: A white-and-gold celestial gateway with tall blue panels between golden pillars, standing on a fluffy white cloud, a broad white stairway descending from the gate to the ground.

name: Cyclops Cave
description: A conical hill of dark brown rock with rough ridges and a huge dark cave mouth in its front.

name: Forsaken Palace
description: A round domed palace with red-and-white vertical stripes ringed by huge curved red horns rising from its base, a slender spire on top, on a dark red stone foundation.

name: Serpent Fly Hive
description: Two tall jungle trees with slender dark trunks and dense green leafy crowns, glowing orange hive pods clinging to the trunks, on a small earthen mound.

name: Earth Elemental Conflux
description: A shallow crater of brown earth ringed by jagged brown rock spikes, a dark muddy pool with rocks in its middle.

name: Fire Lake
description: A pool of molten gold-orange lava with two small pavilions crowned by shining golden-orange onion domes standing in it.

name: Fire Elemental Conflux
description: A ring of jagged dark rock enclosing a large dome of sculpted roaring orange-yellow flames over molten lava.

name: Parapet
description: A tall tiered tower: a round domed base of grey stone with a steep stone stairway climbing to it, upper tiers narrowing to a pinnacle crowned by a stone gargoyle with spread wings.

name: Altar of Wishes
description: A tall tiered tower faced with blue glazed tiles and gold trim, arched openings on every tier, topped by a copper onion dome and a needle spire.

name: Hall of Sins
description: A small fortress of dark red-brown and black stone with crenellated walls and a round tower topped by a big cauldron, molten gold pouring from it into a pool of glowing yellow-orange liquid in the courtyard.

name: Gorgon Lair
description: A low squat bunker of dark grey stone with a dark entrance, a huge golden bull head with long curved horns mounted on its roof.

name: Dragon Cliffs
description: A very tall pointed spire of brown rock pitted with dark cave holes and ledges, a few small pine trees at its foot.

name: Griffin Tower
description: A grey stone tower-gatehouse with crenellations and an arched gate perched on top of a mossy green rocky crag, a winding path leading up to it.

name: Harpy Loft
description: A tall rugged spire of dark rock with ledges, a large nest of twigs and straw holding pale eggs on its summit.

name: Kennels
description: A loose group of rust-red iron cages of different sizes and tall bone-white pillars stained red, standing on bare ground.

name: Hydra Pond
description: A dark murky pond with muddy banks enclosed by a low fence of green bamboo poles tied together.

name: Lizard Den
description: A cluster of rounded brown mud-and-stone domes stacked together, with dark burrow holes.

name: Mage Tower
description: A very tall slender conical tower of sandstone tapering to a needle-thin spire, a long straight stairway climbing up its front from a shallow round sunken base.

name: Manticore Lair
description: A ruined patch of ground strewn with pale bones and grey stone rubble, two tall slender grey stone pillars and a few broken column stumps standing among them.

name: Chapel of Stilled Voices
description: A round drum-shaped chapel of dark stone with red bands, a golden ribbed dome on top and a red stone stairway leading up to an arched door.

name: Labyrinth
description: A low square block of grey stone walls forming a winding maze open at the top, with one entrance in the front.

name: Monastery
description: A small monastery of brown stone: a round central hall with a conical brown tiled roof and two lower wings with tiled gable roofs, small arched windows.

name: Golden Pavilion
description: An oriental palace of red-brown and grey stone with two tall round towers topped by small golden domes, a big golden ribbed dome over the main hall, arched windows and blue trim.

name: Demon Gate
description: A red-brown stone gate shrine with a dark arched portal, two enormous curved white-tipped horns rising from its roof, spiky posts at its corners.

name: Ogre Fort
description: A round grey stone keep with crenellations, surrounded by a low ring wall of rough sharpened wooden stakes.

name: Orc Tower
description: A tall tapering round tower of beige stone in stacked tiers banded with dark stone, a dark domed top and a small arched door at its base.

name: Hell Hole
description: A pit of glowing red lava with a dark rocky rim, a tall dark red stone gate frame at its back holding a fiery circular emblem.

name: Dragon Cave
description: A low wide heap of glittering gold coins and treasure with a few pale pink crystal shards sticking out around its edge.

name: Cliff Nest
description: A tall rugged pinnacle of dark grey rock with a big nest of wooden beams and branches on its top and a glowing red hole in its face.

name: Cloud Temple
description: A white marble classical temple with a colonnade of slender columns, topped by a tall round tower with blue bands and a white dome.

name: Dendroid Arches
description: A tangle of huge twisted brown tree roots and gnarled branches curving into arches over a mossy patch of ground.

name: Water Elemental Conflux
description: A round fountain pool of clear blue water with tall arching jets of water, ringed by sculpted stone fish statues spouting water and a grassy rim.

name: Tomb of Souls
description: A tall ruined tower of dark grey stone, broken and crumbling at the top, fallen blocks at its foot.

name: Wyvern Nest
description: A conical mound of earth, sticks and straw propped up by a few long leaning wooden poles.

name: Enchanted Spring
description: A tall brown rock with a waterfall pouring down its front into a small pool, a silver statue of a winged horse standing on its top.

name: Unicorn Glade
description: A grove of dense round green trees with a low stone gateway and two small stone lanterns at its front.

name: Mausoleum
description: A tall pointed tower-mausoleum of grey stone with buttresses, crowned by a round dome shaped like a skull.

name: Estate
description: A two-storey manor house of grey-blue stone with flat terraced roofs, dark wooden beams and benches on the roof terraces and an outside staircase.

name: Altar of Thought
description: A large upright golden ring frame on a small stone base holding a glowing blue mirror-like disc, a small golden star finial on top.

name: Pyre
description: A small stone ring from which a narrow column of sculpted flame rises into a wide flat swirling disc of purple, red and orange fire, all one connected shape.

name: Frozen Cliffs
description: A tall cluster of jagged pale blue ice crystal spires of different heights.

name: Crystal Cavern (dwelling)
description: A cluster of tall pale pink-red quartz crystal spires growing from the ground, a small barred cave opening at their foot.

name: Magic Forest
description: Bulbous purple onion-shaped houses like giant mushrooms with small windows among dark green pine trees, a small blue pond and a curved stone stair.

name: Sulfurous Lair
description: A stepped pyramid of rough brown rock with small dark vents and rubble at its base.

name: Enchanter's Hollow
description: A mossy grey-green rock hollow with a glowing golden cave entrance, surrounded by dense green trees.

name: Treetop Tower
description: Two wooden watchtowers on tall stilts with conical thatched roofs among green trees, joined by a wooden ladder.

name: Unicorn Glade (small)
description: A small grove of dense green trees with two stone lanterns standing in front of it.

name: Altar of Air
description: A square grey stone platform with steps, pale crystals at its corners and a swirling white cloud vortex in its centre.

name: Altar of Earth
description: A low dark grey-green rocky platform crowned by a ring of jagged dark stone spikes.

name: Altar of Fire
description: A round dome of sculpted flickering orange fire inside an open shell of dark rock, stone steps at the front.

name: Altar of Water
description: A round pool with a golden rim and small golden statues around it, blue water and a fountain of arching water jets in the middle.

name: Thatched Hut
description: A small stone cottage with a thick golden straw thatched roof, small windows, a wooden door and a chimney.

name: Hovel
description: A small wooden hut with a thatched roof and a little fence, nestled among tall green pine trees.

name: Boar Glen
description: A dirt path leading into a glade between dense green leafy trees and bushes.

name: Tomb of Curses
description: A sandstone pyramid with a large sphinx statue lying in front of it.

name: Nomad Tent
description: A conical tent of red-and-white vertical stripes with a dark entrance flap.

name: Rogue Cavern
description: A rocky hill overgrown with green bushes, a dark cave entrance at its foot with barrels, crates and sacks piled in front.

name: Troll Bridge
description: An arched stone bridge with low parapets and small corner turrets with red conical roofs, spanning a little blue stream.

name: Elemental Conflux
description: A stone platform with four round stone basins: one with roaring sculpted fire, one with a fountain of blue water, one with swirling white cloud, one with earth and rubble; a white stone domed centrepiece between them.

name: Golem Factory
description: A tall industrial building of dark grey metal and stone with big curved pipes, a round boiler, several chimney stacks and wooden plank parts.

name: Maelstrom
description: A round rocky basin holding a swirling grey-blue whirlpool vortex, a tall mossy grey rock peak rising at its back.

name: Nymph Waterfall
description: A tall mossy grey rock with a small waterfall streaming down its front into a little pool at its foot.

name: Shack
description: Two wooden two-storey stilt houses with whitewashed walls and dark timber frames on a small hill overgrown with jungle plants.

name: Frigate
description: A wrecked wooden sailing ship hull lying on rocks and gravel, a single broken mast, gold coins scattered around.

name: Nest
description: A tall twisted brown trunk like a palm tree crowned by a cluster of large pale yellow curved fronds, rocks around its base.

name: Tower of the Seas
description: A very tall slender round tower of dark green-black stone with rows of small yellow lit windows and pale stone bands, a white domed lantern top, on a round stepped base.

name: Nix Fort
description: A low fortified hall of grey stone with a dark tiled roof, a big red arched gate in front and two armoured warrior statues standing on the roof corners.

name: Wineyard
description: A small wooden cottage with a shingle roof built against a huge wooden wine barrel lying on its side, a round door in the barrel end, a stone chimney.

name: Ziggurat
description: A stepped temple of mossy green stone with two pointed spires and horn-like ornaments, a round window and a dark doorway.

name: Alehouse
description: A timber-framed two-storey house with white plaster walls and dark beams, a green tiled roof and a tall chimney.

name: Halfling Adobe
description: A sandy beige adobe house with flat roofs at different levels, outside stairs, a roof terrace with a small tree and a green awning.

name: Foundry
description: A tall narrow workshop of orange-brown brick with arched windows and a tall chimney rising from its roof.

name: Ranch
description: A wooden wind pump tower with a many-bladed wheel on a timber frame, next to a wooden fenced corral and a water trough.

name: Manufactory
description: A red-brick factory hall with an arched roof ribbed with white stripes, a wide arched gate and three tall chimneys.

name: Catacombs
description: A low round domed mound of brown stone with a ribbed iron grate over a round opening on top and stone steps at the front.

name: Watchtower
description: A fortified sandstone base with a tall wooden watchtower rising from it, a lookout balcony and a pointed shingle roof.

name: Serpentarium
description: A square sandstone building with tall blue arched windows and a lush garden of tropical green plants on its flat roof.

name: Gantry
description: A tall frame of four parallel arched copper-bronze ribs on stone footings with round finials on top, a chain hanging between them.

name: Colliery
description: A mound of dark grey coal rock with a timber-framed mine entrance and a wooden crane hoist on top.

name: Frigid Spur
description: A rock outcrop of grey-green basalt columns crowned with pale turquoise ice crystals, a dark cave mouth at its foot.

name: Hall of the Bold
description: A long Nordic longhouse with a steep wooden shingle roof, timber walls and round painted shields hung along its side wall.

name: Mountain Embassy
description: A round domed hut of hides and stones with an enormous horned beast skull and tusks over its entrance.

name: Shaman Fane
description: A ring of grey standing stones joined by stone lintels on top.

name: Mammoth Stalls
description: A long low stone stable with a wavy dark wooden shingle roof and a big arched door framed by curved tusks.

name: Frosthome
description: A tall Nordic hall of grey stone and dark timber with steep dark roofs and gables, turquoise-glowing windows and an arched gate.

name: Cyclops Stockpile
description: A craggy brown rock outcrop with a big timber-and-stone storehouse built into it, a round wooden wheel-like door in its front.

name: Dwarven Treasury
description: A massive hall of mossy beige stone blocks with a steep stone gable roof and an iron portcullis gate.

name: Griffin Conservatory
description: A grey stone gatehouse tower with crenellations and an iron portcullis, built on a brown rocky outcrop.

name: Imp Cache
description: A square grey stone shrine with a stepped roof, a small flame burning on its top and a barred door.

name: Medusa Stores
description: A ruin of pale grey-green stone walls and broken arches overgrown with green moss and creepers.

name: Naga Bank
description: A beehive-shaped dome of carved sandstone with ornate relief patterns, an arched door at the front and a small round lantern turret on top, on a round grassy base.

name: Dragon Fly Hive
description: A huge gnarled brown tree with twisted branches, round papery hive nests hanging along the branches.

name: Beholders' Sanctuary
description: A square sandstone temple tower with carved reliefs and a dark doorway, standing on a small rocky islet.

name: Temple of the Sea
description: A colossal grey stone statue of a bearded sea king with a spiked turquoise crown rising to the waist, a turquoise trident in one hand, cradling a small turquoise-domed temple in the other arm.

name: Pirate Cavern
description: A rocky hill with a cave entrance framed by timber beams and lit from within, tropical palm plants around it, barrels in front and a carved skull above the entrance.

name: Mansion
description: A large three-storey manor of cream walls and dark timber with steep red-brown roofs, dormers and gables, bare dead trees beside it.

name: Spit
description: A big mossy green rock shaped like a giant dragon skull with a glowing red cave mouth, overgrown with moss and small plants.

name: Red Tower
description: A tall two-tiered tower of red-lacquered wood and brick with flared red pagoda roofs on golden posts, a golden spire on top and a red brick base with a door.

name: Black Tower
description: A tall narrow tower of dark grey fieldstone with a pointed dark slate roof flanked by small corner turrets, a small door at its foot.

name: Ivory Tower
description: A tall slender tiered tower of white ivory stone with many small windows, topped by a pointed violet crystal.

name: Churchyard
description: A graveyard enclosed by a black wrought-iron fence: grey tombstones and crosses, a small stone statue and a gnarled tree with pink blossoms.

name: Experimental Shop
description: A ramshackle workshop of timber and slate with metal pipes, a brass dome and two smoking chimneys.

name: Wolf Raider Picket
description: A squat tower of stacked rough beige stone blocks with barred windows and a dark doorway.

name: Ruins
description: A ruined circular sandstone fortress with a broken round tower and crumbled walls overgrown with grass.

name: Dragon Utopia
description: A large terracotta-red castle with many round towers with red conical roofs and a tall central keep, standing on a pale rocky plateau.

name: Crypt
description: A wide classical mausoleum of pale beige stone with a flat roof, columns carved with skulls, a dark central door with steps and two braziers with red flames by the entrance.

name: Shipwreck
description: A broken wooden ship hull lying half-sunk and tilted, a snapped mast with torn rigging.

name: Derelict Ship
description: A dark wooden sailing ship with two masts, torn rigging and tattered grey sails, its hull battered.

description: A fortified gateway: a short crenellated wall of pale grey-pink fieldstone with a barred iron portcullis in the middle, flanked by two round towers with conical red clay-tile roofs and dark arched doors; plain stone, no coloured panels.

name: Quest Gate (vertical)
description: A fortified wall of pale grey-pink fieldstone running straight from front to back, seen end-on: a round tower with a conical red clay-tile roof at the front end and another at the back end, a barred gate passage in the middle of its long side.

name: Quest Guard
description: A narrow round watchtower of dark grey fieldstone with a conical red clay-tile roof topped by a small finial and a dark arched doorway at its foot, plain stone walls.

name: Grave (border gate)
description: A small low mound of freshly dug brown earth with a few stones and a bone sticking out.

name: Garrison
description: A short fortified wall of sandy beige rubble stone with crenellations and a barred iron gate in the middle, flanked by two squat round towers with dark grey conical slate roofs.

name: Anti-Magic Garrison
description: A short fortified wall of sandy beige rubble stone with crenellations and a barred iron gate in the middle, flanked by two squat round towers with dark grey conical slate roofs; small pale-violet rune stones set into the walls and towers.

name: Garrison (wooden)
description: A wooden fort wall of sharpened vertical logs with a barred gate in the middle, flanked by two square log towers with flat lookout tops.

name: Anti-Magic Garrison (wooden)
description: A wooden fort wall of sharpened vertical logs with a barred gate in the middle, flanked by two square log towers with flat lookout tops; small pale-violet rune carvings on the logs.

name: Garrison (dark stone)
description: A fortified gate between two round towers of dark grey stone with spiky silver-white conical roofs; the gate between them is a twisted lattice of dark curved wooden and iron beams.

name: Garrison (vertical)
description: A fortified wall of sandy beige rubble stone running straight from front to back, seen end-on: a squat round tower with a dark grey conical slate roof at the front end and another at the back end, the crenellated wall between them with a barred gate in its long side.

name: Anti-Magic Garrison (vertical)

name: Garrison (wooden, vertical)

name: Anti-Magic Garrison (wooden, vertical)
description: A wooden fort wall of sharpened vertical logs running straight from front to back, seen end-on: a square log tower with a flat lookout top at the front end and another at the back end, a barred gate in the middle of its long side; small pale-violet rune carvings on the logs.

name: Trading Post
description: A log cabin with a thick golden straw thatched roof and a stone chimney, barrels and a crate in front of it.

name: Black Market
description: A market stall with a dark slatted canopy roof on wooden posts, tables piled with goods, a cart wheel and barrels beside it.

name: Altar of Sacrifice
description: A low square altar platform of rust-red bricks stained dark red, a broken stone arch fragment standing at its back corner.

name: Freelancer's Guild
description: A big round fortress of three joined towers of pale stone and dark timber, each with a dark ribbed dome ringed by white tusk-like spikes, an arched gate in front.

name: War Machine Factory
description: A long workshop of stone and timber with a wooden shingle roof, a large open forge door glowing red and a chimney.

name: Cannon Yard
description: A large timber-framed workshop with a red tiled roof and two tall stone chimneys, an outside stone stair, glowing furnace openings and heaps of black cannonballs.

name: Junkman
description: A covered wooden caravan wagon with a barrel-vaulted plank roof, a market stall with a green awning and crates beside it.

name: Arena
